author: Top Gear
description:
In this video Top Gear reviews the new Bentley Supersports. It takes the luxurious Bentley Continental GT as its base, but ditches everything from the front driveshafts to the back seats, plus the heavy hybrid system, to create a stripped-out super GT with a 666hp V8 and the ability to shred its rear tyres on demand.

🚗 Bentley Supersports
